patch_summary: Linear transform block size 64 -> 4 and the M>K joint ridge 1e-3 -> 1e-2. The Linear path permutes channels to group similar ones and then block-Hadamards them; a 64-wide block re-mixes that grouping. Swept on two banks the score rises monotonically 64>32>16>8>4 and collapses at 2. Official wide group 0.423636 -> 0.573123 (+747 of 50) and the 10-group mirror 0.753340 -> 0.760204 (+34), so both banks move the same way. Linear calibration data is real, so this is a legal, structure-agnostic change.
